title: Redis
label: Redis
desc: In-memory data store used as a cache, message broker and low-latency database.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the server, start it and set the first connection defaults.

snippets.code:
# Debian and Ubuntu
sudo apt update
sudo apt install redis-server redis-tools
sudo systemctl enable --now redis-server

# Fedora, Arch and Alpine ship Valkey, the community fork that provides redis
sudo dnf install valkey
sudo pacman -S valkey
sudo apk add valkey

# On those packages the client is valkey-cli
valkey-cli PING

# macOS with Homebrew
brew install redis
brew services start redis

# Confirm the server answers on the default port
redis-cli PING

docker run --name redis-cache \
  -p 6379:6379 \
  -v redis-data:/data \
  -d redis:7.4

# Open a client inside the running container
docker exec -it redis-cache redis-cli

# redis.conf
bind 127.0.0.1 -::1
port 6379
protected-mode yes
requirepass devsecret
maxmemory 512mb
maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
appendonly yes

sections.title: Connection
sections.description: Open a client session and inspect how the server sees it.

snippets.code:
# Host, port and logical database index
redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 -n 2

# Password without the warning banner
redis-cli -a devsecret --no-auth-warning

# URI form; rediss:// adds TLS
redis-cli -u redis://default:devsecret@cache.internal:6379/0
redis-cli -u rediss://cache.internal:6380/0

# Read the password from the environment instead of the command line
REDISCLI_AUTH=devsecret redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 PING

# Name this connection so it is easy to find in CLIENT LIST
redis-cli CLIENT SETNAME worker-1
redis-cli CLIENT GETNAME

# Every open connection, with age and last command
redis-cli CLIENT LIST
redis-cli CLIENT INFO

# Build, role and uptime of the server
redis-cli INFO server
redis-cli INFO replication

sections.title: Strings
sections.description: Store plain values, counters and byte ranges under a single key.

snippets.code:
# Write with a 15 minute lifetime
SET session:42 "token-9f2c" EX 900
GET session:42

# NX writes only when the key is absent; XX only when it exists
SET session:42 "token-9f2c" NX
SET session:42 "token-1a7b" XX KEEPTTL

# Return the previous value while replacing it
SET session:42 "token-77d1" GET

# Read and delete in one atomic step
GETDEL session:42

SET page:views 120
INCR page:views          # 121
INCRBY page:views 40     # 161
DECRBY page:views 5      # 156
INCRBYFLOAT price:usd 12.50

APPEND log:line "first;"
APPEND log:line "second;"
GETRANGE log:line 0 4     # "first"
STRLEN log:line            # 13
SETRANGE log:line 6 "SECOND"

MSET user:1:name "Ana" user:2:name "Rui"
MGET user:1:name user:2:name user:3:name

sections.title: Hashes
sections.description: Keep small records as field-value maps without separate keys.

snippets.code:
HSET user:1001 name "Ana Lima" email "ana@example.com" age 34
HGET user:1001 name
HMGET user:1001 name email
HGETALL user:1001
HKEYS user:1001
HLEN user:1001
HEXISTS user:1001 phone

HINCRBY user:1001 age 1
HINCRBYFLOAT metrics:cpu 0.75

# Set only when the field does not exist yet
HSETNX user:1001 country "BR"

HDEL user:1001 email
HSCAN user:1001 0 MATCH "na*" COUNT 100

sections.title: Lists
sections.description: Use insertion-ordered sequences for queues, feeds and stacks.

snippets.code:
RPUSH queue:jobs "render-101" "render-102" "render-103"
LRANGE queue:jobs 0 -1
LPOP queue:jobs
RPOP queue:jobs 2
LLEN queue:jobs
LINDEX queue:jobs 0

LPUSH feed:ana "post-9" "post-8"

# Keep only the newest 50 entries
LTRIM feed:ana 0 49

LINSERT feed:ana BEFORE "post-8" "post-7"
LREM feed:ana 1 "post-9"
LPOS feed:ana "post-8"

# Block up to 5 seconds for the next job
BLPOP queue:jobs 5

# Move atomically, waiting up to 10 seconds for a source item
BLMOVE queue:jobs queue:active LEFT RIGHT 10

sections.title: Sets
sections.description: Track unique members and compare groups with set algebra.

snippets.code:
SADD tags:post:7 "redis" "cache" "backend"
SCARD tags:post:7
SISMEMBER tags:post:7 "cache"
SMISMEMBER tags:post:7 "cache" "sql"
SMEMBERS tags:post:7
SREM tags:post:7 "backend"

SADD online:mon "ana" "rui" "lia"
SADD online:tue "rui" "tom"

SINTER online:mon online:tue
SUNION online:mon online:tue
SDIFF online:mon online:tue

SRANDMEMBER deck 2
SPOP deck
SMOVE queue:a queue:b "job-9"
SSCAN tags:post:7 0 MATCH "c*"

sections.title: Sorted Sets
sections.description: Rank members by score and query them by value or range.

snippets.code:
ZADD leaderboard 1200 "ana" 980 "rui" 1450 "lia"

# Raise the score only if the new one is higher, count changed members
ZADD leaderboard GT CH 1300 "ana"

ZRANGE leaderboard 0 -1 WITHSCORES
ZREVRANGE leaderboard 0 2 WITHSCORES
ZSCORE leaderboard "rui"
ZRANK leaderboard "rui"
ZINCRBY leaderboard 75 "rui"

ZADD events 1700000000 "deploy" 1700003600 "rollback" 1700007200 "deploy-hotfix"
ZCOUNT events 1700000000 1700003600
ZRANGEBYSCORE events 1700000000 1700003600 WITHSCORES

# Exclusive lower bound, open upper bound, first two results
ZRANGEBYSCORE events "(1700000000" "+inf" LIMIT 0 2
ZREMRANGEBYSCORE events "-inf" 1700000000

ZADD names 0 "ana" 0 "bruno" 0 "carla" 0 "diego"
ZRANGEBYLEX names "[bruno" "[diego"
ZRANGEBYLEX names "-" "+" LIMIT 1 2
ZLEXCOUNT names "[ana" "[carla"

sections.title: Keys and Scanning
sections.description: Find keys without blocking the server and inspect their metadata.

snippets.code:
# One cursor step; call again with the returned cursor until it is 0
SCAN 0 MATCH "user:*" COUNT 200
SCAN 0 TYPE hash COUNT 500
SCAN 1240 MATCH "session:*" COUNT 200

EXISTS user:1001 user:1002
TYPE user:1001
DBSIZE
RANDOMKEY

RENAME draft:7 post:7
COPY post:7 post:7:backup
UNLINK temp:upload:9

# KEYS walks the whole keyspace and blocks the server; use it only in emergencies
KEYS "user:*"

OBJECT ENCODING user:1001
OBJECT FREQ user:1001     # requires an LFU maxmemory-policy
OBJECT IDLETIME user:1001

sections.title: Expiration
sections.description: Give keys a lifetime and control when it starts or ends.

snippets.code:
SET cache:home:1 "html-v42" EX 300
TTL cache:home:1
PTTL cache:home:1
PERSIST cache:home:1

# NX applies only when no TTL exists; XX GT extends only a shorter one
EXPIRE cache:home:1 60 NX
EXPIRE cache:home:1 120 XX GT
EXPIRETIME cache:home:1

SET otp:ana "481920" PX 90000

# Keep the value, reset its lifetime
GETEX otp:ana EX 120

# A short lock that disappears on its own
SET lock:report "worker-3" NX PX 30000

# Absolute deadlines in Unix time survive relative-TTL drift
EXPIREAT session:42 1767225600
PEXPIREAT session:42 1767225600000

sections.title: Pub/Sub
sections.description: Fan out messages to connected subscribers in real time.

snippets.code:
# First terminal: wait for messages on two channels
redis-cli SUBSCRIBE orders:created orders:cancelled

# Second terminal: send one message, the reply counts receivers
redis-cli PUBLISH orders:created '{"id":8123,"total":149.90}'

# Pattern subscription covers every channel with the prefix
redis-cli PSUBSCRIBE "orders:*"

redis-cli PUBSUB CHANNELS "orders:*"
redis-cli PUBSUB NUMSUB orders:created
redis-cli PUBSUB NUMPAT

# Sharded pub/sub keeps channels on one cluster slot
redis-cli SSUBSCRIBE cache:invalidate
redis-cli SPUBLISH cache:invalidate "user:1001"

sections.title: Transactions
sections.description: Batch commands and guard them with optimistic locking.

snippets.code:
# Queue the commands, then run them as one block
MULTI
SET account:1:balance 900
INCRBY account:2:balance 100
EXEC

# Discard the queue before EXEC and nothing is applied
MULTI
DECRBY stock:sku:44 2
DISCARD

# Abort if account:1:balance changes between WATCH and EXEC
WATCH account:1:balance
GET account:1:balance
MULTI
DECRBY account:1:balance 250
INCRBY account:2:balance 250
EXEC

# EXEC replies nil when the watched key was modified by someone else
UNWATCH

sections.title: Streams
sections.description: Append an ordered log and consume it with consumer groups.

snippets.code:
XADD orders '*' customer "ana" total 149.90

# Cap the log near 10000 entries, trimming whole nodes
XADD orders MAXLEN ~ 10000 '*' customer "rui" total 39.50

XLEN orders
XRANGE orders - + COUNT 10
XREVRANGE orders + - COUNT 3
XREAD COUNT 5 BLOCK 2000 STREAMS orders '$'

# Create the group at the start of the stream, creating the stream if needed
XGROUP CREATE orders workers 0 MKSTREAM

# '>' means never-delivered entries for this group
XREADGROUP GROUP workers worker-1 COUNT 10 STREAMS orders '>'

XACK orders workers 1731234567890-0
XPENDING orders workers
XPENDING orders workers - + 10

# Take over entries idle for more than 60 seconds
XAUTOCLAIM orders workers worker-2 60000 0-0 COUNT 20
XCLAIM orders workers worker-1 60000 1731234567890-0

XINFO STREAM orders
XINFO GROUPS orders

sections.title: Persistence
sections.description: Choose between snapshots and an append-only file for durability.

snippets.code:
# Snapshot in a background child process
redis-cli BGSAVE
redis-cli LASTSAVE
redis-cli INFO persistence

# Replace the automatic snapshot rules at runtime
redis-cli CONFIG SET save "3600 1 300 100 60 10000"
redis-cli CONFIG GET save

# Turn on the append-only file and fsync once per second
redis-cli CONFIG SET appendonly yes
redis-cli CONFIG SET appendfsync everysec

# Compact the log in the background
redis-cli BGREWRITEAOF

# redis.conf
dir /var/lib/redis
dbfilename dump.rdb
save 3600 1 300 100 60 10000
appendonly yes
appendfsync everysec
auto-aof-rewrite-percentage 100

sections.title: Performance
sections.description: Measure latency, memory and slow commands before tuning.

snippets.code:
# Round-trip latency and a live command counter
redis-cli --latency
redis-cli --stat

# Largest keys and hottest keys in the dataset
redis-cli --bigkeys
redis-cli --hotkeys    # needs an LFU maxmemory-policy

# Log commands slower than 5 milliseconds
redis-cli CONFIG SET slowlog-log-slower-than 5000
redis-cli SLOWLOG GET 10
redis-cli SLOWLOG RESET

redis-cli LATENCY DOCTOR
redis-cli LATENCY HISTORY command

redis-cli INFO memory
redis-cli MEMORY USAGE user:1001 SAMPLES 0
redis-cli MEMORY DOCTOR

# Cap memory and evict the least recently used keys when full
redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory 1gb
redis-cli CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
